explanationMd: The supplier claims the coating explains the entire fuel saving. The operator wants evidence for how much it actually explains after accounting for other changes. That attributable effect is the measured contribution.

distractorRationale.d: The context concerns causal effect on fuel use.
distractorRationale.a: Route length is not the contribution being estimated.
distractorRationale.c: Appearance is not the performance effect.
